project_type: AWS CDK v2 TypeScript infrastructure-as-code project
build_system: npm scripts wrapping tsc, jest, eslint, prettier, cdk synth
test_framework: Jest with ts-jest transform and aws-cdk-lib/assertions (Template.fromStack pattern)
verification_instructions: Run in order: npm run format, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run cdk-nag. All must pass.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node.js v22 available (package.json requires >=24 but works). No Docker needed.
contribution_requirements: Branch naming: feat/<name>. PR title: Conventional Commits format. Run npm run format before committing. All CI checks must pass: format-check, lint, typecheck, cdk-nag.
key_patterns: Namespace imports for CDK modules (import * as s3 from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-s3'). import type for type-only imports. PascalCase for construct IDs. enforceSSL on queues. All encryption via existing ExampleProjectKey KMS key. cdk-nag acknowledgements via cdk.Validations.of(resource).acknowledge(). Single quotes, semicolons, trailing commas. 100 char line width.
directory_structure: bin/ - CDK app entry point. lib/ - Stack definitions exported via index.ts barrel. test/ - Jest tests using CDK assertions. .kiro/steering/ - Project conventions.
